color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Known write scope?

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Investigation. Read widely. Write almost nothing
1 Intake: symptom card. Ask the missing facts once
2 Reproduce: tests/repro only. Fail for the reported reason,
in a clean environment. Repeat to measure flakes
3 Localize: temporary logs on a quarantined branch
4 Prove: a second model checks the note. A minimal change
flips the test, and undoing it flips it back
5 Fix: a normal task, scope = the proven files
6 Keep: the reproduction joins the permanent suite
No reproduction, no fix. Each stage has a cap
Hypotheses are logged. The same experiment is refused
Past the cap: ask for a recording or HAR, or ship logging behind a flag

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A sweep changes a symbol, dependency or pattern across features,
or more than 15 files. It is the only owner of those paths
Exclusive lease on the compiler and search result
Maintenance window: drain in-flight work there, start no new work there,
leave unaffected work running
Branch harness/s/id from integration, landed like a feature
Afterwards, briefs are rewritten from the symbol map and re-checked

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Choose by evidence
Used to work, and a good commit exists: git bisect run
One engine only: differential run, compare network, cookies, console
Intermittent: many runs, jitter, traces of pass and fail
Server-side: correlation ID, temporary spans
Data-dependent: shrink the input to the smallest failing case

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Safari logout, as specified
WebKit: cookie missing after the checkout redirect
Chromium keeps it. SameSite=Strict is dropped on the way back
Lax flips the test. Revert flips it back
Fix scope is the session file. A reviewer checks the auth rules

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Does the fix touch the proven mechanism?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Flag it. Two tests must pass: the symptom, and the mechanism
Reverting the fix must fail both. reviewer asks: cause, or cover?

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 Read-only research: guide, changelog, known codemods
2 Official codemod, language-service rename, ts-morph, ast-grep
or jscodeshift. A model may write a script that is reviewed, then run
3 Checklist: type errors, tests, lint, and string hits
4 Residual fixes in dependency order. One commit per batch
5 Type check, full suite, journeys, leftover scan
6 Senior review of the non-mechanical diff
Cannot submit while an error, a failing test or an unallowlisted leftover remains
Parallel only when partitions are disjoint and each compiles alone

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 Symptom patches are flagged. Two regression tests
2 Bisect only a stable fingerprint. Exit 125 skips a broken commit
Fresh sandbox per step. Confirm by reverting on current code
3 Search every name form, including strings, SQL, config and docs
Persisted names are keep or migrate, never a silent rename
4 All-or-nothing leases. Intent mode. Tasks do not wait while holding
Overlapping sweeps are serialized
5 Packets fit the model. Hunks, not whole-file rewrites
Elision placeholders are refused
6 Behavior-preserving sweeps record characterization tests first
AST flags await, defaults, ?? versus or, equality and timeouts
7 Start from latest integration. Land in stages. Recompute the checklist
after merging. Schema changes take the schema lease
8 Workers never write the knowledge database. One test database per attempt
Retry from a fresh worktree and database. Sweeps resume from the last batch
9 Several projects share one broker, with an interactive lane
10 SQLite is inside the app. The CLI is optional and read-only
A foreign commit is seen via data_version, then integrity check and safe mode

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cannot reproduce: stay open, with the hypothesis log
Cause is a dependency: upgrade, patch or workaround, with the upstream link
The report is a missing feature: send it to discovery
No compatible library version: stop, and offer pin, replace or wait
The developer edits during a sweep: merge, then recompute the checklist
